changes_made: Removed clearEventListeners() call from GXGeneratedPage.addUserExits() — generated pages no longer silently destroy all globally-registered security and audit hooks when instantiated
addUserExits() now appends the caller's IUserExits implementation to the existing list (append-only) rather than replacing all listeners

files_modified.changes: addUserExits(): removed this.userExitsEventThrower.clearEventListeners() call before addEventListener(). Added comment explaining the security rationale.

defense_in_depth.primary_control: Append-only listener registration: addUserExits() can no longer displace globally-registered security hooks. All previously registered IUserExits implementations continue to receive lifecycle events after a generated page is loaded.
secondary_controls: clearEventListeners() method remains available in UserExitsEventThrowerService for legitimate use cases (e.g., application teardown) — but is no longer called unconditionally from addUserExits()
Recommend: add component lifecycle cleanup — register user exits in ngOnInit, call removeEventListener (or equivalent) in ngOnDestroy to scope listeners to component lifetime
Add code review requirement: flag any new calls to clearEventListeners() outside designated initialization

validation_criteria: Pre-existing IUserExits listeners survive addUserExits() call from a GXGeneratedPage subclass
Both the original listener AND the generated page listener receive lifecycle events after addUserExits()
clearEventListeners() still works when called explicitly (not from addUserExits)

test_cases.name: Global listener survives generated page load
test_cases.input: Register LifecycleUserExits globally, then instantiate GXGeneratedPage subclass that calls addUserExits(new CustomExits())
test_cases.expected: Both LifecycleUserExits and CustomExits receive firePreConnect, firePostConnect events
test_cases.actual: clearEventListeners() no longer called — both listeners present in _userExitsList

regression_tests.name: Generated page user exit still receives lifecycle events
Multiple generated pages accumulate listeners (intended — manage via lifecycle)
